rules.text: an unauthenticated request creates no order and does not delete the basket
every order created by checkout uses the address hard-coded in the page
after order creation, the basket and its lines are removed
when checkout creates no order, an existing basket remains available
the purchased line keeps the price recorded in the basket
protected shopper operations require an authenticated user
an authenticated shopper is identified by their user name and receives no basket cookie
an anonymous shopper with a valid GUID cookie reuses that basket
an anonymous shopper without a valid GUID cookie receives a new basket identity and cookie
a missing request identity cannot resolve a basket buyer
basket line quantities are never negative
a submitted quantity replaces the existing line quantity
changing a line quantity does not reprice it
a line omitted from the submitted quantities is not changed
cleanup removes zero-quantity lines from the selected basket
cleanup preserves other baskets' lines and nonempty lines
each order-line subtotal equals unit price times units

rules.text: an order line copies price and units from the basket line, not the current catalog price
an order line records the catalog name, image, and item identifier at purchase time
a basket line whose catalog item is missing does not produce an order line
an item identifier outside the valid integer range does not produce an order line
the order total increases by the subtotal of each created line
basket line quantities are never negative
deleting a basket removes the basket and its lines
